notes.title: Ver.2.4 Update: Graphics Boost & Smoother Gameplay!
notes.content: [p]This update brings a major visual upgrade while keeping the core gameplay intact. Here's what's new:[/p][list][*][p]Enhanced effects using tessellation and more[/p][/*][*][p]Bone-based character animations (20 types: walk, idle, push, fall, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p]HDR support for richer visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad support for smoother control[/p][/*][*][p]Music originally made with SD-90 now reimagined using Cubase 14 Pro + HALion 7 + Groove Agent SE 5 + Simple Tank 4[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimizations to reduce processing load[/p][/*][*][p]Anisotropic filtering enabled (no anti-aliasing)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character system removed — now fully bone-driven animation[/p][/*][*][p]Handy features like placement assist now selectable from settings[/p][/*][/list][p]You can turn off effects to get a DirectX9-style look, but performance impact is minimal — so we recommend keeping them ON.[/p][p]From Ver.2.2 to Ver.2.4, it's a big leap. Enjoy the upgrade![/p]
